semanticNodes.canonicalMeaning: Table Header and Unit Specification for Non-Commercial Counterparty Credit Risk Exposures
semanticNodes.structuralScopeDescription: This node represents the combined semantic header of Table 1 3. It integrates the unit specification ('In millions of U.S. dollars') with the temporal scope ('Exposures as of March 31 2025') and the table title context. The occurrences are semantically bound because they jointly define the metadata required to interpret the subsequent data rows (Notional, Net Exposure).
